entities.name: Church of San Fermín de los Navarros

entities.summary: The Church of San Fermín de los Navarros is a church located in Madrid, Spain. It is dedicated to Saint Fermin, and replaces an earlier church dedicated to the saint which was demolished to make way for the Bank of Spain.
